text.tspan: The room becomes an interview room
A relation map of access, applications and competing authority.
Care and a proposed hiring process
Asks for the key; brings the applications.
Takes down the spare and holds the forms.
Their current workers must also apply.
Arrives as an applicant with his own pen.
B > A: obtains access / B > D: claims to fill early / C > D: offered RETAIN / DISMISS / E > A: comes for interview / B > C: leaves her to answer
The process claims the power to retain or dismiss; its practical reach is not established.
